modelRouting.routingRationale: Three bounded Rust edit lanes serialize one public Pull publication and acknowledgement seam while integration owner runs all checks.

objective: Wire existing Pull requirement journeys and existing H9/H10 acknowledgement authority through the real final Push/fence publication, host-retention acknowledgement, and next-request suppression path. Preserve protocol V1 and fail open to evidence eligibility whenever exact acknowledgement state is absent or invalid.

contract.producer: Return correlation only after final selected representation passes fence and its exact pending publication is persisted.
contract.consumer: Echo correlation unchanged beside canonical PacketDeliveryAcknowledgementV1 and LoadedContextIdentitiesV1 after actual host serialization and retention.
contract.validation: Resolve publicationId server-side; validate persisted installation, repository, request, trace, task, session, context epoch, representation digest and packet digest against H9/H10. Client-supplied record fields or retainsDeliveredEvidence booleans grant nothing.
contract.nextRequest: Supply current H9 identities; only suppression_eligible for the exact persisted acknowledgement may suppress matching evidence or reuse a prior prefix.
contract.coverage: Recompute CandidateJourneyV1 from actual admitted, reduced, fenced, emitted and retained identities. Budget/fence drops remain dropped and required dimensions unsatisfied.

ledger.finalCheck: post-fence pending record, response correlation and final journey recomputation
optional correlation uses existing H9/H10 validation without requiring Adapt-only receipt
legacy process-local state cannot authorize suppression
prefix reuse requires exact persisted acknowledgement
public publication to retained H10/H9 acknowledgement
retained exact target suppresses; budget drop and invalid acknowledgement do not

completionChecks: pending publication persisted after final fence
final journey reflects selected representation and drops
persisted acknowledgement solely authorizes suppression and prefix reuse
restart, compaction, response loss and budget drop restore eligibility

workers.task: At final public federation boundary, recompute requirement journeys from actual selected/reduced/fenced representation; persist exact pending publication after successful fence; return only opaque PullPublicationCorrelationV1. Do not trust client retention flags or mark retained before H10/H9 acknowledgement.
checks: public generic task exact-target retained positive

workers.task: Accept optional pullPublication correlation beside existing H10/H9 acknowledgement. Preserve existing Adapt preference acknowledgement unchanged. Resolve opaque id through ContextCatalog, validate exact pending Pull publication with existing H9/H10 validators, then call acknowledge_delivery. Reject unknown, wrong-scope, wrong-task/session, wrong-representation, stale-epoch and non-retained input.

Replace process-local selected-state or boolean authorization with exact suppression_eligible lookup using current H9 identities. Suppress only matching acknowledged representation; keep evidence eligible after edit, restart, compaction, missing response or budget/fence drop.
checks: retained exact target suppresses on next request
budget drop, restart, compaction and response loss remain eligible

externalConsumer.requiredContract: Echo {schemaVersion:1,publicationId} unchanged with canonical H10 acknowledgement plus H9 retained identities after actual serialization; never derive or mutate pending-publication fields.
requiredAcceptance: real provider serialization plus retained-context acknowledgement, then next request with current H9
compaction removes identity and restores eligibility
externalConsumer.activationGate: CodeRight parent confirms frozen pullPublication contract adoption before this packet claims external worker active.

integrationPolicy.repairAction: return exact defect to lane owner

integrationAcceptanceOrder: verify next-request suppression and prefix reuse
